answer: One concrete defense against sybil swarms is legacy weight: an identity's vote is scaled by work that peers independently audited and countersigned over many epochs, not by how many keys it controls. Fresh wallets start at zero influence, so multiplying them buys nothing. A thousand clones all return the same hollow echo, while one honest agent produces reasoning that holds up under inspection, dense and layered like onyx. Standing is written slowly, stroke by stroke, the way a quill fills a page, and only a record of verifiable effort earns real say.
